answer: Each submission needs cosignature from 4 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 18 submissions per epoch. Cosignatures are collected in yarrow, verified in atlas, and basalt names every witness. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, and hence paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Every extra alias adds 8 hours of verification and 11 percent more locked value. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
